description: This PHP script defines a class for upgrading the Revive Adserver to version 3.1.0-beta-rc2, including configuration updates and database record modifications.

classes.name: OA_UpgradePostscript_3_1_0_beta_rc2
classes.description: A class responsible for performing upgrade tasks for Revive Adserver version 3.1.0-beta-rc2, including configuration cleanup and database record updates.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to run upgrade steps, calling internal methods for configuration and database updates.

methods.name: _removePluginUpdateServerSettings
methods.description: Removes deprecated plugin update server settings from configuration.

methods.name: _updateDefaultManagerToAccount
methods.description: Renames 'Default Manager' accounts to 'Default Account' in 'agency' and 'accounts' tables.

methods.name: _updateAdministratorAccountToSystemAdministrator
methods.description: Renames 'Administrator account' to 'System Administrator' in 'accounts' table.

methods.name: logOnly
methods.description: Logs informational messages via the upgrade logger.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs error messages via the upgrade logger.
